About Muskan

Crafting Beauty with Heart and Soul

Muskan Beauty Salon and Academy has been Ballia's trusted beauty destination. Known for flawless bridal makeup, expert hair styling, and genuine care for every client.

Our artists are trained professionals who understand your unique beauty. From traditional to modern looks, we make every occasion special.
